business_summary: Latvian local service website for custom kitchens. The verified offer is kitchen-specific design and planning, manufacture, delivery and installation, tailored to the customer's home and needs. The primary conversion is a consultation request. The preview form is not yet connected to a webhook.

notes_for_research: Use Google Latvia and Latvian. The site is currently a noindex preview and robots.txt disallows crawling, so current-ranking results may be empty; label that as an indexation-state limitation rather than evidence of no demand. Earlier DataForSEO research dated 2026-07-28 produced 153 qualified keywords and the existing 16-page demand architecture. A separate 40-phrase location follow-up reported no measurable volume. Preserve low and zero values but do not treat them as proof. Discover competitors from live non-branded SERPs; no competitor list is owner-approved. Distinguish organic keyword difficulty from paid competition. Test whether broad/custom-kitchen, design/planning/interior, manufacture/product, price/installation-price, built-in/custom and component/retail intents overlap. Do not make final page decisions.
